questions.stem: 和傳統手錶相比，智慧手錶多了許多專為監測心跳而設計的功能。
questions.answer: Compared with traditional watches, smart watches have many more functions designed to monitor heart rates.
accepted_answers: Compared to traditional watches, smart watches offer many more functions designed for monitoring heart rates.
Compared with ordinary watches, smart watches come with many more features designed to monitor users' heart rates.

questions.stem: 每天看著手錶上的數據，許多使用者發現運動得愈多，就愈有活力。
questions.answer: Looking at their watch data every day, many users find that the more they exercise, the more energetic they feel.
accepted_answers: Looking at the data on their watches daily, lots of users find that the more they work out, the more energetic they become.
Checking the data on their watches every day, many users discover that the more they exercise, the more energetic they are.

1.explanation_zh: 「和…相比」用 Compared with/to + N，放句首後面加逗號；compared 是過去分詞，不寫 compare。「專為監測心跳而設計的功能」是前置修飾，英文先寫 functions，再用過去分詞片語 designed to monitor heart rates 放在後面（功能是被設計的，所以用 designed）。functions 可數，「多了許多」用 many more。
evidence: 專為監測心跳而設計的功能
1.strategy_zh: 「被…的＋名詞」先寫名詞，再用過去分詞片語（designed／made／used …）接在後面；比較的對象放在 Compared with 後面。
hints: 切成四段：和傳統手錶相比／智慧手錶多了許多／專為監測心跳／而設計的功能
標的詞彙：compare（比較，L2）、traditional（傳統的，L2）、smart（智慧的，L1）、function（功能，L2）、design（設計，L2）、monitor（監測，L4）、heart rate（心跳，L3）
句型框架：Compared with + N, S + have many more + N + p.p. + to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 前半句「每天看著手錶上的數據」沒有寫出主詞，主詞就是後面的「使用者」，英文用分詞構句 Looking at …, many users find …（不能用原形 Look 開頭）。「愈…就愈…」用 the + 比較級 + S + V, the + 比較級 + S + V；「有活力」是形容詞 energetic，接在 feel／become 後面。
evidence: 每天看著手錶上的數據
運動得愈多，就愈有活力
2.strategy_zh: 中文前半句沒主詞、而且和後半句主詞相同時，想分詞構句：主動用 V-ing、被動用 p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：每天看著手錶上的數據／許多使用者發現／運動得愈多／就愈有活力
標的詞彙：look at（看著，L1）、data（數據，L2）、watch（手錶，L1）、user（使用者，L2）、exercise（運動，L1）、energetic（有活力的，L3）
句型框架：V-ing …, S + find that + the + 比較級 + S + V, the + 比較級 + S + V

references: Compared with traditional watches, smart watches have many more functions designed to monitor heart rates.
Compared to traditional watches, smart watches offer many more functions designed for monitoring heart rates.
Compared with ordinary watches, smart watches come with many more features designed to monitor users' heart rates.

patterns.frame: Compared with/to + N, S + V + 比較級 …

patterns.label_zh: 過去分詞片語後位修飾名詞
patterns.zh_trigger: 專為監測心跳而設計的功能

common_errors.explanation_zh: 句首表「和…相比」用過去分詞 Compared，不用原形 compare。
智慧手錶是「被拿來比較」的，用 Compared with，不用 Comparing。

accepted: smart watches come with many more
smart watches have a lot more

common_errors.wrong: smart watches have much more functions
common_errors.right: smart watches have many more functions
common_errors.explanation_zh: functions 是可數名詞，「多出許多」用 many more，不用 much more。

common_errors.wrong: smart watches are more many functions
common_errors.right: smart watches have many more functions
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「多了」是「擁有更多」，用 have many more，不用 be 動詞。

accepted: to keep track of heart rates

common_errors.explanation_zh: for 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 monitoring；或改用不定詞 to monitor。
表目的的 to 是不定詞，後面接原形動詞。
功能是「被設計」的，要用過去分詞 designed 放在名詞後面修飾。

common_errors.wrong: designed functions to monitor heart rates
common_errors.right: functions designed to monitor heart rates
common_errors.explanation_zh: 修飾語 designed to … 很長，要放在名詞 functions 後面。

traps.literal_error: Compared with traditional watches, smart watches have much more function designed to monitor heart rates.
traps.explanation_zh: function 可數：複數要加 s，「多出許多」用 many more。

traps.zh: 專為監測心跳而設計的功能
traps.literal_error: Compared with traditional watches, smart watches have many more specially designed to monitor heart rates functions.
traps.explanation_zh: 長的修飾語照中文放在名詞前面，英文不通；要寫 functions designed to monitor heart rates。

1.restructuring_zh: 「專為監測心跳而設計的功能」修飾語在名詞前面，英文要先寫 functions，再用過去分詞片語 designed to monitor heart rates 後位修飾。

references: Looking at their watch data every day, many users find that the more they exercise, the more energetic they feel.
Looking at the data on their watches daily, lots of users find that the more they work out, the more energetic they become.
Checking the data on their watches every day, many users discover that the more they exercise, the more energetic they are.

Looking at the data on their watches daily
Looking at the data on their watches every day

Checking their watch data every day

common_errors.wrong: Look at their watch data every day, many users find
common_errors.right: Looking at their watch data every day, many users find
common_errors.explanation_zh: 前半句沒有主詞，不能用原形動詞開頭，要改成分詞構句 Looking at …（或補主詞：When they look at …）。

common_errors.wrong: Looked at their watch data every day
common_errors.right: Looking at their watch data every day
common_errors.explanation_zh: 使用者是「主動」看數據，用現在分詞 Looking。

accepted: a lot of users find that

common_errors.explanation_zh: many 後面接複數名詞 users。
主詞 users 是複數，動詞不加 s。
「愈…愈…」兩半句都要用 the + 比較級 開頭。
比較級已經移到前面，句尾不再重複 more。
feel 後面接形容詞 energetic；用名詞 energy 要說 the more energy they have。
後半句也要用 the + 比較級 開頭，形成 the more …, the more … 的對稱結構。

traps.zh: 每天看著手錶上的數據
traps.literal_error: Look at their watch data every day, many users find that the more they exercise, the more energetic they feel.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文前半句沒寫主詞，照字面用原形動詞開頭會變成兩個子句沒有連接；改成分詞構句 Looking at …。

traps.literal_error: Looking at their watch data every day, many users find that the more they exercise, the more energy they feel.
traps.explanation_zh: 「有活力」是形容詞 energetic，接在 feel 後面；名詞 energy 不能直接接在 feel 後面。

1.translation: Compared with traditional watches, smartwatches have many more functions that are specially designed to monitor heart rates.
1.explanation_zh: 「和…相比」用過去分詞片語 Compared with 開頭（主詞 smartwatches 是被比較的一方）；「多了許多」譯 have many more functions；「專為監測心跳而設計的功能」用 that are specially designed to 的關係子句（被動）。

2.translation: Looking at the data on their watches every day, many users find that the more they exercise, the more energetic they become.
2.explanation_zh: 「每天看著…」和主詞 many users 主動關係，用現在分詞構句 Looking at…；「運動得愈多，就愈有活力」用 the + 比較級…, the + 比較級…；「發現」接 that 名詞子句。

issues_zh: 「智慧手錶」我寫成一個字 smartwatches（主要字典的標準拼法），但 references 和 P2 accepted 只有 smart watches，程式也比對不到標的詞 smart；建議 P2 accepted 補 smartwatches、smart 的 alternatives 補 smartwatch。

句型 PART：我用的是未減化的關係子句 functions that are specially designed to monitor…，不是 N + p.p. 的減化分詞；因為 P4 accepted 本來就收 functions that are designed，程式也判定有 PART，所以列入 used_patterns。如果出題者要嚴格要求減化分詞，這一句要視為中文沒有自然引出 PART。

problems: 第 1 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：「智慧手錶」我寫成一個字 smartwatches（主要字典的標準拼法），但 references 和 P2 accepted 只有 smart watches，程式也比對不到標的詞 smart；建議 P2 accepted 補 smart

1.translation: Compared with traditional watches, smartwatches have many extra features designed specifically to monitor heart rate.
1.explanation_zh: 「和……相比」用 Compared with 開頭的分詞片語，主詞 smartwatches 邏輯上正確；「專為……而設計」用過去分詞 designed specifically to 修飾 features。「心跳」我自然會寫 heart rate。

2.translation: Looking at the data on their watches every day, many users have found that the more they exercise, the more energetic they feel.
2.explanation_zh: 「每天看著……」用現在分詞片語，主詞 many users 就是看數據的人；「運動得愈多，就愈有活力」用 the more…, the more… 句型。

issues_zh: （建議，不影響判定）句型 COMP 的 frame 寫「Compared with/to + N, S + V + 比較級」，但「多了許多」不一定要用比較級；我用 many extra features 自然表達，所以只用到 Compared with 的部分，沒有比較級，程式因此看不出 COMP。建議放寬 frame，或在第 2 部分 accepted 補 have many extra。
（建議，不影響判定）目標詞彙 smart 只比對得到分開寫的 smart watch(es)；現在通用的單字寫法 smartwatch(es) 比對不到，建議在 smart 的 alternatives 補 smartwatch。

problems: 第 1 題驗證者說用了句型 COMP，程式在譯文裡看不出來
